cellTypeLabels.name: label
cellTypeLabels.documentation: A human-readable label for this labeling (e.g. 'G&T 2026 subclass, NN transfer').

cellTypeLabels.name: label_name
cellTypeLabels.documentation: The name of the labeled variable as it appeared in the source (e.g. 'subclass_nn_column', 'leiden').

cellTypeLabels.name: taxonomy_level
cellTypeLabels.documentation: Where this sits in a class/subclass/type hierarchy, if any. Free text; use '' for flat or unsupervised labelings.

cellTypeLabels.name: n_cells
cellTypeLabels.documentation: The number of data rows in labels.tsv. Must equal the n_cells of the document this one depends on, and rows must be in the same order.

cellTypeLabels.name: n_categories
cellTypeLabels.documentation: The number of distinct non-empty categories.

cellTypeLabels.name: n_unlabeled
cellTypeLabels.documentation: How many cells have no category. Column-region and QC labelings are often mostly empty.

cellTypeLabels.name: assignment_method
cellTypeLabels.documentation: How labels were assigned (e.g. 'nearest-neighbor transfer from a dissociated atlas', 'Leiden clustering', 'manual'). A transferred label is an inference about the cell, not a measurement of it.

cellTypeLabels.name: is_unsupervised
cellTypeLabels.documentation: 1 if the labels come from unsupervised clustering and therefore carry no biological identity. Leiden and SNN clusterings must set this to 1 so they are not mistaken for cell type calls.
